gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of an intracranial diffuse glioma (i.e. diffuse astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma or glioblastoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase I/II Combination Study of NMS-03305293 and Temozolomide in Adult Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type glioblastoma (Phase 2) at first relapse

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma samples will be collected and used for pharmacokinetics assessments

role_evidence.quote: aimed at defining the Maximum Tolerated Dose (MTD) and the Recommended Phase 2 Doses (RP2Ds) of NMS-03305293 in combination with TMZ
All patients will receive NMS-03305293 and temozolomide (TMZ) administered orally

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype as per WHO 2021 classification
Sufficient tissue representative of the disease available for central MGMT promoter methylation status (Phase I and II) and IDH status evaluation (Phase I).

coder_notes: IDH-wildtype is required for the Phase 2 and backfill cohorts only (Phase 1 accepts any diffuse glioma), so coded enrichment; it defines GBM per WHO 2021 and is never candidate-matched. MGMT: central testing required and 'Sponsor may opt to restrict enrollment based on MGMT status', but no fixed MGMT requirement is registered; coded exploratory_correlative. Temozolomide is given to all patients in the single arm (rechallenge at first relapse) and coded soc_backbone; the investigational question is NMS-03305293. PK is plasma and urine only.
